title: Average MRR per enterprise-segment account, as of 2025-08-31
prompt: Among enterprise-segment accounts with a subscription active on 2025-08-31, what's the average monthly recurring revenue (their plan's monthly_price) per account?
population: Enterprise-segment accounts with a subscription active on 2025-08-31, joined to that subscription's plan.
metricDefinition: average(monthly_price) of the subscription active on 2025-08-31, across enterprise accounts that have one.
referenceSql: SELECT avg(p.monthly_price) AS avg_mrr_per_account FROM accounts a JOIN subscriptions s ON s.account_id = a.account_id JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE a.segment = 'enterprise' AND s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-08-31' AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-08-31')
